requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several issues with incorrect data handling and incomplete test coverage. Many test cases are failing due to improper handling of edge cases in integer encoding, string encoding, and list encoding.
requirement.contract: Fix the RLP encoding implementation to correctly handle all test cases in test_rlp_encoding.py. Specifically, ensure that: 1. Integer encoding properly handles all values including zero and values exceeding 127 2. String encoding correctly processes different str_modes ('text', 'hex') and handles empty strings 3. List encoding properly handles nested structures and maintains correct length prefixes 4. The implementation should match Ethereum RLP specification exactly

requirement.description: The RLP decoding implementation is incomplete and fails to properly handle various data types and modes. Several test cases are failing due to inability to decode data correctly.
requirement.contract: Complete the RLP decoding implementation to properly support all test cases in test_rlp_encoding.py. Specifically: 1. Fix the rlp_decode function to properly decode ASCII, raw_hex, and prefix_hex types 2. Handle edge cases in decoding including empty data and malformed encodings 3. Ensure compatibility with the rlp package when available, but provide robust fallbacks

requirement.description: Missing cryptographic dependencies causing import errors in signature-related functions. Tests requiring ecdsa and hashlib packages are failing because these dependencies are not properly handled.
requirement.contract: Ensure that cryptographic functions properly handle missing dependencies: 1. Improve error messages to clearly indicate missing packages 2. Make the ecdsa and hashlib dependencies properly optional or add proper checks 3. Ensure all signature-related functions work when dependencies are available

requirement.description: CREATE2 address computation is failing due to missing hashlib dependency and improper error handling.
requirement.contract: Fix the get_created_address function to properly handle CREATE2 address computation: 1. Ensure hashlib is properly imported and used 2. Add proper error handling for invalid inputs 3. Fix the keccak hash computation for CREATE2 addresses

requirement.description: The implementation is missing the __future__ import annotations in several files which is causing test failures.
requirement.contract: Add the missing __future__ import annotations to all Python files in the binary module to ensure consistency with the project's standards.
